It maps each component string to supportedVersions.get. So if any component equals a key, returns that VersionFlag.

For unrecognizable schema: use something like "unknown". Expect JsonSchemaException thrown.

Also detect(JsonNode) should throw when $schema missing.

Also test that when both present, $schema takes precedence (since stream order detectOptionalVersion first). Provide both with different values and ensure $schema wins.

detectOptionalVersion(String): test valid and invalid.
